name: Transverse and longitudinal waves and wave speed

terms.definition: Oscillations are perpendicular to the direction of energy transfer, such as ripples on water.
Oscillations are parallel to the direction of energy transfer, with compressions and rarefactions, such as sound.
terms.examiner: Waves transfer energy, not the medium.

terms.definition: The maximum displacement of a point on a wave from its undisturbed position.
terms.examiner: Measured from the middle, not peak to trough.

terms.definition: The distance from a point on one wave to the equivalent point on the next.
terms.examiner: Measure across several waves and divide.

terms.definition: The number of waves passing a point each second, in hertz (Hz).
The speed at which energy is transferred through the medium: v = f λ.
terms.examiner: Required practical: ripple tank and waves on a string.
